The on-site has moved. It's now **Tuesday Dec 15 to Thursday Dec 17, 2026**, at the Austin office.

- On Nov 16, the Ardent QSA asked to move the on-site from Dec 8–10 to Dec 15–17. Their second assessor has a conflict the week of Dec 7. Shira accepted the same day [3].
- Some sources still show the old Dec 8–10 dates. Avi's Slack reminder on Nov 17 says Dec 8–10 and tells people to book flights by the end of the week [2]. The evidence tracker [1] and the Nov 9 portal email [4] also still show Dec 8–10. The Nov 17 reminder is more recent than the change, but it looks like it was written without knowing about it.
- The Dec 1 deadline for the evidence package hasn't changed [3].

Before you book, check with Shira or Avi that Dec 15–17 is final. The Austin holiday party is Fri Dec 11 and the TLV party is Thu Dec 17, which may matter for your travel [5].
